# Sparrow Collect

> Sparrow Collect is an AI-powered iPhone app (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6767359453; Android coming later) that scans, identifies, and values collectibles across 56 categories. Values are built from marketplace listings and price data (eBay, TCGplayer, Cardmarket, Discogs, and other marketplace data), and each value shows how it was derived, so collectors can track portfolio value, compare live listings, set watchlist target-price alerts, and decide when to buy or sell. One app for trading cards, figures, vinyl, watches, LEGO, sneakers, comics, and more.

## What it does

- **Scan & identify**: Point your camera at an item; AI identifies the item, edition, and variant, and estimates its condition from the photo. Barcode and ISBN scanning too.
- **Value**: Low/mid/high price range, with how it was derived (how many market prices, which sources, which market: US, European, or both). When data is thin, the app says so instead of guessing. Shown in EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, KRW, AUD, or CAD.
- **Track**: Portfolio dashboard with total value, what you paid (incl. tax and shipping) against current value, biggest movers, and CSV export.
- **Alerts**: Add items to your watchlist with a target price and get notified when the market reaches it.
- **Deal discovery (Pro)**: Purchase mandates describe what you want and your budget; matching listings are surfaced as deals.

## Pricing

- **Free**: Scan and catalogue your items, see each value with how it was derived, and profit/loss against what you paid.
- **Sparrow Pro (monthly or yearly, via Apple In-App Purchase; price shown in the App Store)**: 10 purchase mandates, unlimited watchlist, unlimited Target Hit alerts, deal discovery, set completion for trading-card sets, advanced analytics.

- [Guides](https://sparrowcollect.com/guides): In-depth collector guides and 80+ answered questions on identifying, grading, and valuing collectibles.
